subject: Combining Startup Credits with Dedicated Discount + Rev-share Ask
messages:

Cc: procurement@orbitlabs.co
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Startup program stacking + dedicated discount + rev-share proposal

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the great product walkthrough last week — excited about what Redwood can do for inference cost at scale. Orbit Labs is preparing a 6‑month pilot and we have two asks we'd like to combine into a single commercial agreement if possible: 1) stack Redwood's startup/accelerator credits with a short-term Dedicated capacity discount (we expect to reserve 2 x A100 equivalent for inference), and 2) in exchange for a deeper discount, Orbit is offering a modest revenue share model (we can pay 3–5% of net revenue tied to the product lines using Redwood, or alternatively convert that to additional usage credits).

Key context: our pilot forecast is ~120M tokens/month (spiky 99th pct latencies), expected to convert to paid production in Q4. Procurement would like to understand whether credits from the startup program can be consumed against reserved capacity invoices or if they only apply to hosted usage. Also need a simple mutual action plan + SOW we can route internally. I attached a draft SOW (OrbitLabs_SOW_v1.pdf) and a quick forecast sheet.

Can Redwood combine credits and reserved discounting, and would your team be open to discussing the rev-share option as credits or cash?

Looking forward — Jamie

--
Jamie Park

jamie@orbitlabs.co | +1 415 555 0114

Hi Jamie — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the SOW + forecast. Appreciate the context. Short answers up front: yes, we can usually apply startup promo credits to hosted usage; dedicated (reserved) invoices are treated differently but we have mechanisms to subsidize committed capacity via upfront credits or direct percentage discounts. Rev-share as a commercial instrument is less common for our standard programs — finance prefers credits or milestone-based rebates — but we can discuss.

Proposed next steps:
- I'll run this internally with Sales Ops and Finance to produce a concrete counterproposal (credits + reserved discount + earnback mechanics).
- Can you confirm expected monthly committed spend (baseline after discount) and whether the A100 equivalent will be sustained or bursty? That will affect the discount tiers.
- Share the PO template / procurement timelines so I can align legal.

Looping in Ben (lead AE) and Aditya (sales manager) to scope a narrowed commercial doc. Ben/Aditya — please advise if we can offer a stacked credits + reserved discount for a 4–6 month pilot and whether we can convert rev-share into a monthly credit rebate.

Best,
Marissa

--

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: RE: Startup program stacking + dedicated discount + rev-share proposal

Marissa / Aditya — quick internal note before finance weighs in: Orbit looks like a strong small-GTM account, high token volume but pilot stage. I think a pragmatic offer is: $50k startup credit drawdown + 30–40% off Dedicated list for 3 months, then step down to our standard reserved discount. Rev-share — push it into a credits-earnback tied to monthly spend (e.g., 3% of invoice converted to credits applied the following month). That keeps billing simple and avoids revenue recognition headaches.

I'll flag that we need an explicit clause: credits cannot be used to offset contractual minimums for dedicated reserved capacity (we can allow them to be applied as post-invoice credits). Also include a 60‑day termination/adjustment window for forecast delta >20%.

Attaching a quick price calc (price_calc.csv) so Finance can eyeball the impact.

— Ben
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: startup stacking — finance view

Team — finance view / constraints:
- We cannot sign an open-ended revenue share that requires future cash payouts tied to a customer’s top-line (compliance + rev recognition).
- Approveable option: a monthly usage rebate where X% of the invoice is returned as Redwood usage credits (applied the following month). Credits must expire after 12 months and cannot reduce minimum committed spend below the committed threshold.
- Discounting: short pilots can have higher upfront discounts (30–40%) for up to 3 months; anything beyond that needs exec approval and a simple milestone plan.

If Sales wants to offer $50k in promo credits + 30% reserved discount for 4 months, we can accept that with the rebate structure: 3% monthly invoice rebate converted to credits, 12‑month expiry, credits applied post-invoice. Also require a PO and an authorized signatory.

— Lauren (Finance)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@orbitlabs.co>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Startup program stacking + dedicated discount + rev-share proposal

Hi Jamie — appreciate your patience while we reviewed internally. Below is our counterproposal for Orbit Labs pilot: 

Summary offer
- $50,000 promotional Redwood startup credits (applied to hosted usage; can be used as post-invoice credits against Dedicated invoices but not to reduce committed minimums).
- 30% off list price for Dedicated (reserved) capacity for a 4‑month pilot (applies to billed reserved line items).
- Monthly rebate: 3% of each monthly invoice converted to Redwood usage credits, applied in the following billing cycle. Credits expire 12 months after issuance.
- No cash revenue share.
- Standard 60‑day adjustment window if actual usage deviates >20% from the forecast.

Required next steps
1) Confirm the committed configuration (2x A100 equivalent reserved) and a one‑page PO with billing contacts.
2) Sign SOW / commercial addendum (DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/sign/ABC123-orbit).
3) Provide your month 0 forecast and expected start date so we can provision Dedicated capacity.

Attachments: OrbitLabs_SOW_v1.pdf (your draft, annotated), Orbit_Terms.xlsx (commercial summary).

If this matches what you need, we'll issue a commercial addendum and a simple mutual action plan. Happy to hop on a short call today to walk through timelines.

Best,
Marissa
